Project notes:
- Discord bot notifications are implemented with discord.js.
- The web dashboard is a Next.js app that manages auth, guild/channel/role selection, and anime imports.
- Anime tracking currently uses AniList public GraphQL data for release timing and supports AniList username imports plus MyAnimeList XML imports.
